title: Pickleball Pro Tips (with Michelle)
style: pop, comedic, catchy, Australian slang, comedy

[Intro]
Whoo!
[Verse]
Look
It's my buddy
Michelle
And she's got a paddle
Paddle
Paddle
A real pro
Yeah
She doesn't need to battle
Battle
Battle
The court
It seems so big and mighty
Big and mighty
But with Michelle's help
You won't be left to die
Left to die
[Chorus]
And Michelle says
"Oi! What the hell are you doing?"
You gotta move your feet
You gotta find your position
You gotta stay in line
If you're getting too far forward
They'll just whack you
And if you keep your paddle too low
You're gonna get whacked in the head
Mate
Keep your paddle up
[Verse 2]
Michelle's the greatest coach in the land
In the land
And when you're with her
You will get to Grand
Get to Grand
She's the best pickleball coach I've ever had
I've ever had
And she said I was bad
[Chorus]
She said
"Oi! What the hell are you doing?"

You gotta stay in line

Mate
Keep your paddle up
